open_points.subject: activate_budget_version
open_points.text: activate_budget_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_active_budget_version of the budgets repository of that transaction, a BudgetRepository, and through its get_budget_version and its list_budget_plans.
open_points.other_text: activate_budget_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST use one transaction and one budgets repository of the transaction for the requested version, active version, ordered plans, and one update_budget_versions call; the project's expenses, with their allocations flattened, are read only through list_project_expenses of the expenses repository of that transaction, an ExpenseRepository, called with the project_id of the context, and the success audit MUST be appended with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction.
open_points.question: Must every read and write use only get_active_budget_version, get_budget_version, and list_budget_plans, or must the function also call update_budget_versions, list_project_expenses, and append_audit as required by the other note?

open_points.subject: ensure_manual_budget
open_points.text: ensure_manual_budget: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through insert_budget_version of the budgets repository of that transaction, a BudgetRepository.
open_points.other_text: ensure_manual_budget: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction by beginning a transaction with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction, obtain one stable BudgetRepository as the budgets repository of that transaction, read the manual version through get_manual_budget_version, read its plans through list_budget_plans, and read the project's expenses, with their allocations flattened, only through list_project_expenses of the expenses repository of that transaction, an ExpenseRepository, when computing unresolved allocations.
open_points.question: Must every read and write go through insert_budget_version, or must reads instead use get_manual_budget_version, list_budget_plans, and list_project_expenses as the other note requires?

open_points.subject: get_budget_version
open_points.text: get_budget_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through list_budget_plans of the budgets repository of that transaction, a BudgetRepository.
open_points.other_text: get_budget_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction, read the exact version and its plans only through one budgets repository of the transaction, read the project's expenses, with their allocations flattened, only through list_project_expenses of the expenses repository of that transaction, an ExpenseRepository, called with the project_id of the context, and close that read transaction by exactly one rollback of that transaction.
open_points.question: Must every read use list_budget_plans, or must the function also read the exact version and call list_project_expenses as required by the other note?

open_points.subject: upsert_manual_section_plan
open_points.text: upsert_manual_section_plan: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_manual_budget_version of the budgets repository of that transaction, a BudgetRepository, and through its insert_budget_version, its list_budget_plans and its upsert_section_plan, and through get_project_section and insert_project_sections of the project_sections repository of that transaction, a ProjectSectionRepository.
open_points.other_text: upsert_manual_section_plan: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST perform optional manual-version creation, optional PortalSection insertion, SectionPlan upsert, required audits, and final reads through one shared transaction using the repositories of that transaction for budgets, for project sections and for audits, and read the project's expenses, with their allocations flattened, only through list_project_expenses of the expenses repository of that transaction, an ExpenseRepository; it MUST NOT call ensure_manual_budget or validate_project_section from inside that transaction.
open_points.question: Must every read and write be made only through the listed budget and project-section repository operations, or must the function also perform the required audit writes and list_project_expenses read through their repositories?
